Name: Ginger Island Beach House
Author: collingbe
Description:
[b][color=#ffff00][size=4]Update: [/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b][size=3]the walls and floors can now function properly, meaning you can change the wallpapers/floorings, and put furnitures on the walls.[/size][/b]
[*][b][size=3]some minor bug fixes[/size][/b]
[/list]
[size=4][color=#ffff00]更新：[/color]
[list]
[*][size=4]壁纸和地板现在可以更换了，也可以在墙上放家具了[/size]
[*][size=4]一些bug的修复[/size]
[/list][/size]


[size=2]How to have two different looking kitchen for your two farmhouses：[/size]
[/b][size=2]I'm using a modified version of[b] [/b][/size][size=2][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1018]Chic Cute Kitchen[/url][b] [/b]made by myself in the screenshot (which i wont be sharing). You can put a png of the kitchen you would like to use in the folder of this mod, the name of the png should be [b]farmhouse_tiles.png[/b]. [/size]

[b]Known Problems!![/b]
[list]
[*]When the farmhouse is first unlocked, the furnitures would be in weird places.
[*][s]Cannot change the walls or floors, or put any funitures on the walls. Unforturnately I modified the house a bit too much, so that the orginal layout of the farmhouse is changed, therefore you are stuck with the walls and floors that i chose. If you are familiar with using tiled, or how to modify the png for mods, its possible to change the walls and floors yourself. [/s]
[*]The fridge cant be opened, but the kitchen is functional.
[/list]
The map recolor is made by me :D, although you can only see a tiny portion of the recolor. 


Please don't hesitate to reach out if you've encountered a bug, or have any suggestions!



[b][size=3]Credits:[/size]
[/b][b][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9139916]DustBeauty[/url] [/b]for her beautiful foliage [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4966]Stardew Foliage Redone[/url].﻿﻿
waterfall by Maleha
Inspired by [url=http://hermajestybuilds.wixsite.com/hermajestybuilds/post/nizuc-villa]Her Majesty Builds[/url]'s Nizuc Villa.﻿




[b]如何使用两种厨房美化：[/b]
截图里我用的是自己改色的[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1018]Chic Cute Kitchen[/url]。如果你不想和主农舍用同一种厨房美化，可以把你想使用的厨房美化的png放在这个mod的文件夹里，注意png的名字应该是[b]farmhouse_tiles.png。[/b]


[b][size=3]已知问题！！[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]刚解锁姜岛农舍时家具会在奇怪的的地方。
[*][s]壁纸和地板无法更换，墙上无法放置家具。由于我对游戏原版姜岛农舍的改动过大，房屋格局也被改动过了，所以只能用我选的壁纸和地板了哈哈哈（被打）。如果你会用tiled或者知道怎么修改png文件，可以自行更换壁纸和地板。[/s]
[*]冰箱无法使用，但厨房功能正常。
[/list]地图美化是我的蓝草嘿嘿嘿（被拖走）


如果在使用该mod时遇到了任何问题，或者有任何建议，欢迎随时戳我！
严禁二传和盗卖，如果被我发现淘宝或咸鱼之类的有人盗卖我的mod，我很可能会直接停止分发我的mod。：）
